info.name: SourceFX
info.comment: Renders a source vector in the effect pipeline.

description.p: The SourceFX class will render a named vector into a given rectangle within the current user coordinate system.

Technically the SourceFX object is represented by a new viewport, the bounds of which are defined by the primitive subregion: the X, Y, Width and Height fields of the effect. The referenced vector is drawn at its own size, with the origin of its user space at the top-left corner of the subregion, and it is clipped to the subregion. The viewport has no view box, so the AspectRatio field does not scale the vector. This is how web browsers place an element referenced by the SVG feImage primitive.

If the subregion is not set, it defaults to the filter region. The vector then moves with the filtered element: with a filter region that starts at (40, 40), a vector point at (0, 0) is drawn at (40, 40). Maps drawn by other routes, such as a pattern fill, will not line up with it. To draw the vector in the user space of the filtered element, set X and Y to 0 and set Width and Height so that the subregion covers the filter region. This applies when the filter's primitive units are user space, which is the default. In SVG:

action.name: Draw
action.comment: Render the source vector to the target bitmap.
action.prototype: ERR acDraw(*Object, DOUBLE X, DOUBLE Y, DOUBLE Width, DOUBLE Height)

input.param: The X position of the region to be drawn.
The Y position of the region to be drawn.
The width of the region to be drawn.
The height of the region to be drawn.

field.name: Source
field.comment: The source Vector that will be rendered.

description.p: The Source field must refer to a Vector that will be rendered in the filter pipeline. The vector must be under the ownership of the same VectorScene that the filter pipeline belongs.

field.name: SourceName
field.comment: Name of a source definition to be rendered.

description.p: Setting Def to the name of a pre-registered scene definition will reference that object in Source. If the name is not registered then ERR::Search is returned. The named object must be derived from the Vector class.
Vectors are registered via the VectorScene.AddDef() method.

field.name: XMLDef
field.comment: Returns an SVG compliant XML string that describes the filter.

constants.comment: Aspect ratios control alignment, scaling and clipping.
constants.const: Aspect ratio is preserved. The entire viewbox will be visible in the viewport. The viewbox is scaled up as much as possible.
Scale the viewbox to match the size of the viewport. Aspect ratio is not preserved.
Aspect ratio is preserved. The viewbox can extend beyond the viewport's edges on one axis. The viewbox is scaled up as much as possible.
